from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from .models import TeamWikiPage

class CreateChildWikiPageView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def post(self, request, parent_page_id):
        parent_page = get_object_or_404(TeamWikiPage, id=parent_page_id, team__members=request.user)
        title = request.data.get("title")
        body = request.data.get("body")

        child_page = parent_page.add_child(
            title=title,
            body=body,
            created_by=request.user
        )
        return Response({"created_id": child_page.id, "parent_id": parent_page.id})
